source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Redundant /normal status in BIOS/BMC
1. Insert required fan on SUT
2. Power on
3. Go to UEFI setup menu to check power information
4. make sure system can boot without error
5. Check power module exist in BMC

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error during POST
2. Check fan rule in Spec
3. Check fan information in BMC

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | grep -iE "fan|redund" ; echo ---sel---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel list last 20 2>&1
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL ipmitool fan SDR + SEL so the user confirms redundant/normal fan presence is reported correctly in BMC; the BIOS-setup fan-availability step is read by the operator in BIOS.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: fan presence/redundancy state is read over IPMI; the BIOS-screen portion requires the operator to view BIOS.

original_test_intent: Verify the required fan population realizes the specified redundant or normal rule, powers on and completes POST without error, and is represented consistently in UEFI/BIOS and BMC.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the mapped fan with the required power/ESD procedure, powers on the SUT, captures POST and UEFI fan/redundancy information, then compares it with complete BMC fan inventory and the owner fan rule.
manual_activity: The physical fan installation, power-on and UEFI setup inspection are core source steps. An agent can collect BMC/SEL evidence but cannot install the module or replace the firmware-screen observation.
required_inputs: Fan module/FRU, slot/population map and redundant-versus-normal rule
Safe powered-off/hot-plug installation, ESD and power-on procedure
Expected POST messages and UEFI fan field; disposition of source wording 'power information'
Expected BMC fan field; disposition of source wording 'power module', OOB recovery and approval
safety_requirements: Do not insert a fan into an energized connector unless the exact platform explicitly authorizes hot-plug.
Verify module/keying/slot and required cooling before power-on.
Use an approved reboot/UEFI path and stop on POST, fan, thermal, power or OOB anomaly.
Preserve physical, firmware and BMC evidence; no repeated reseat or power-cycle automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect unfiltered BMC fan inventory, RPM/status, SEL and host/boot evidence.
Correlate operator installation records and UEFI captures with the supplied fan rule.
Flag the power-module wording conflict and report evidence without claiming manual completion or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve the UEFI/BMC field wording and supply the fan population rule.
Install the fan and capture POST/UEFI evidence under the approved procedure.
Confirm restoration and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Supporting only. Filtered fan/SEL output cannot prove installation, POST or UEFI status, and must not silently reinterpret source power-module fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual install/UEFI method and capture complete BMC fan inventory and SEL using the platform-approved read-only interface; do not use grep output as the full record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Required fan insertion, power-on, UEFI/BMC checks, POST, redundancy rule and both one-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL/FIRMWARE METHOD; CLARIFY FIELD TARGETS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use labeled installation evidence, continuous POST/UEFI capture and a complete BMC inventory export tied to the same fan slots, then reconcile all views with the supplied redundancy table.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, fan FRU, motherboard and BMC/BIOS firmware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record fan FRU, BIOS/UEFI, BMC and CPLD versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan population/redundancy and service documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable slot identity and full evidence while retaining all physical and firmware steps.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; power-module text remains unresolved rather than being silently replaced.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fan map/rule and UEFI/BMC field clarification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC sensor names may not directly expose redundancy groups; a platform map is required.

project_override_considerations: A project may define a particular normal or redundant population and firmware fields, but must record any interpretation of the source's power-information/power-module wording. It cannot replace the physical installation or UEFI check with BMC data alone.
expected_evidence: Fan FRU/slot/population map, redundancy rule, field disposition and authorization
Installation photo/record plus POST/UEFI capture and boot outcome
Complete BMC fan inventory/RPM/status and SEL evidence mapped to physical slots
Final cooling/boot/OOB health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and criteria specify fan redundancy/information, but procedure steps 3 and 5 ask for UEFI power information and a BMC power module. These may be copied PSU wording and cannot be silently treated as fan fields; engineering must state whether they are errors or additional requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The fan population, POST and fan-inventory intent remains clear and safe preparation can proceed. The inconsistent field labels require a recorded engineer disposition but do not make all case semantics unknowable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain read-only BMC support but restore physical/UEFI coverage and identify the source field conflict.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its installation/reboot safeguards; change capability to MANUAL ONLY and make the power-versus-fan wording explicit.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates the narrow source conflict from the otherwise reviewable manual case.

review_improvement: Prevents PSU-like procedure text from being silently rewritten while preserving a complete fan population and redundancy verification plan.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan installation and pre-OS observation are explicit acceptance activities, so the core is manual. At the same time, the procedure's power-module fields do not match the title/criteria; recording that precise conflict is safer than assuming they mean fan inventory or blocking the entire case.
